name: Workspace new window
description:
**Conversation Summary**

1. **Request:** Ctrl+Click (and Cmd+Click on macOS) on a workspace app in the sidebar should open that workspace in a new browser window instead of the in-app panel.
2. **Discovery:** The project already had the exact helper needed — `$ui.openNewWindowAppPanel(app)`, which builds `${origin}${app.path}` and calls `window.open(url, app.name)` — already used in `AppBar.vue`, `AppIcon.vue` and `WorkspacesMenu.vue`.
3. **Implementation:** Updated `src/components/layout/WorkspacesSection.vue` to pass `$event` into `handleSelectWorkspaceApp(app, $event)` and branch on `event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey` before calling the new-window action.
4. **Key decisions:** A single handler was used instead of `@click` + `@click.ctrl` (Vue fires both on Ctrl+Click, which would open the panel *and* the window); an `app.path` guard prevents navigating to `${origin}undefined`; the named window (`app.name`) reuses existing windows rather than spawning duplicates.
5. **Accessibility:** Ctrl+Click is a non-discoverable, pointer-only affordance, so it was deliberately kept as a shortcut only — the explicit "open in new window" button in `WorkspacesMenu.vue` remains available to keyboard users.

messages.content: When user does Ctrl+Click in workspace it will be open in a new window

## Review & Understand the Task

- Ctrl+Click on a **workspace app** (sidebar `WorkspacesSection`) must open that app in a **new browser window**.
- Normal click must keep the current behaviour: open/focus the in-app workspace panel (`$ui.openWorkspace`).
- The project already has this exact capability: `$ui.openNewWindowAppPanel(app)` builds `${origin}${app.path}` and calls `window.open`. It is already used in `AppBar.vue`, `AppIcon.vue` and `WorkspacesMenu.vue`.
- Workspace apps carry a site‑absolute `path` (see `windowManager/Workspace.vue`: `${origin}${app.path}`), so the same helper works here.

## Change Plan

| File | Change | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `src/components/layout/WorkspacesSection.vue` | Pass `$event` into the click handler and branch on `ctrlKey`/`metaKey` | Single handler avoids the double‑fire problem of `@click` + `@click.ctrl`, and covers macOS `Cmd+Click` |
| — | Fallback to normal open when the app has no `path` | Never navigate to `${origin}undefined` |

No store/config changes needed — `$ui.openNewWindowAppPanel(app)` already exists.

### Behaviour

- `Click` → `$ui.openWorkspace(app)` (unchanged).
- `Ctrl+Click` / `Cmd+Click` → `$ui.openNewWindowAppPanel(app)` → `window.open(url, app.name)` (same named window reused per app).
- No `path` → falls back to the panel, so nothing breaks for malformed entries.## Changes Summary

**`src/components/layout/WorkspacesSection.vue`**

| Area | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| Click binding | `@click="handleSelectWorkspaceApp(app)"` | `@click="handleSelectWorkspaceApp(app, $event)"` |
| Handler | Always `$ui.openWorkspace(app)` | Branches on `ctrlKey \|\| metaKey` before opening |
| New-window path | — | `$ui.openNewWindowAppPanel(app)` (existing helper: `${origin}${app.path}` + `window.open(url, app.name)`) |

Notes on the implementation choices:

- **One handler, not two.** Using `@click` + `@click.ctrl` on the same element fires both handlers (the plain click still fires on a Ctrl+Click), which would open the panel *and* the window. Reading `event.ctrlKey` avoids that.
- **`metaKey` included** so macOS users get the native `Cmd+Click` gesture (Ctrl+Click on macOS is the context menu).
- **`app.path` guard** — `openNewWindowAppPanel` builds `${origin}${app.path}`; without a guard a pathless app would open `http://host/undefined`.
- **Named window** (`app.name`) means repeated Ctrl+Clicks on the same app focus the existing window instead of spawning duplicates — identical to the `AppBar` behaviour.

### Accessibility follow‑up (optional)

Ctrl+Click is a power‑user affordance and is not discoverable or keyboard reachable. If you want it discoverable, the cheapest win is a tooltip hint while keeping the collapsed tooltip intact:

```vue
:title="isCollapsed ? app.name : `${app.name} — Ctrl+Click to open in a new window`"
```

Avoid making Ctrl the *only* way to reach the new-window action — the per‑item "open externally" button already present in `WorkspacesMenu.vue` covers that for keyboard/pointer users.
